subtitle: Opening the black box behind every fit() call.

eyebrow: MSE vs. MAE: the choice of loss matters
code:
y_true = [200, 250, 300, 350, 400]
y_pred = [201, 252, 299, 352, 430]   # one $30k miss
mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)    # 182.0 -- squaring, dominated by the miss
mean_absolute_error(y_true, y_pred)   # 7.2   -- same units, less swayed
caption: MSE: smooth, default for regression, sensitive to outliers. MAE: robust, in the target's units.

eyebrow: Log loss: punishing confident wrong answers
caption: Confidently wrong is ~20x worse than confidently right -- pushes models toward honesty.

eyebrow: The good run matches the exact formula
code:
w, b, h = run(0.1, steps=200)
print(round(w,2), round(b,2))         # 80.63  266.53
print(np.round(np.polyfit(x, price, 1), 2))  # 80.63  266.53 -- identical!
caption: Gradient descent, walked carefully, arrives at exactly the same line as closed-form least squares.
